changes.evidence: In Morbius, Michael runs his research and treats children with his blood disease at Horizon Labs in Manhattan, where Martine also works (the Horizon Labs building is a film location; he is jailed for the murder of a Horizon Labs nurse). He never quits or is fired on screen; ending the film a fugitive is not a departure. A real firm, so it counts as his employer.
Twin of A:sv-michael-morbius: same Horizon Labs employment in Morbius, no departure on screen.
In Morbius, Dr. Martine Bancroft is a doctor and scientist at Horizon Labs, working beside Michael; nothing on screen has her leave.

In Madame Web, Ben Parker is an FDNY EMT, Cassie's paramedic partner, and works that job on screen (he revives her after her fall into the water). A real agency; 'FDNY' is an existing dataset name. No departure on screen.
